reason: A named lab and a batch report I can actually open is what I look for, and the dose is on the box with no magnesium oxide. At $24.99 I would try one box, since the money-back is easy.
objection: A foil sachet with two capsules inside every day is a lot of packaging waste when I could just use a bottle. It is also a brand with no reviews yet, so I would check the lab report first.
would_change_my_mind: A bottle or refill option, or recyclable sachets, would make me more comfortable. Seeing the lab report match the batch number before I order would too.
